subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should Himalaya remain bundled long enough to receive a consolidated documentation repair, or should the corrected guidance move to an external ClawHub skill as part of the starter-set trim?
rationale: The open maintainer-authored skill-relocation proposal explicitly includes Himalaya, so the requested repair cannot be safely scoped until its ownership boundary is settled.

options.title: Move Himalaya out of core
options.body: Continue the starter-set trim and publish corrected command and composition guidance as a maintained external ClawHub skill.

options.title: Keep and repair bundled guidance
options.body: Retain Himalaya in the starter set and sponsor one concise documentation PR validated against the supported Himalaya CLI version.

recommendation.title: Move Himalaya out of core
recommendation.body: Continue the starter-set trim and publish corrected command and composition guidance as a maintained external ClawHub skill.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active proposal that changes the Himalaya skill ownership boundary.
